transitions.notes: Absent at Activity generation revision zero → current revision one: predecessor is explicitly absent exactly at revision zero (§11.3, §14.8); appends one immutable Continuation and CASes the one generation head (UNIQUE(activity_stream_id, generation)) in the same transaction.

transitions.authority: participant (R29): owning Participant/Manifestation, or collective channel inside executive policy
transitions.notes: Current revision N → N+1 under expected_head_revision CAS with the current Continuation/digest as predecessor; one concurrent writer wins — the stale writer returns the current opaque head and cannot append; no automatic merge or alternate current branch; current Episode fence when episodic; a stale Episode/Manifestation may retain bytes as local diagnostic evidence but cannot advance the head (§11.3, §14.8) — gap note G28.
